message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 201, "amount_cents": 1083}, {"order_id": 203, "amount_cents": 18687}, {"order_id": 204, "amount_cents": 11000}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 201, "amount_cents": 3873}, {"order_id": 203, "amount_cents": 18687}, {"order_id": 204, "amount_cents": 11000}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 201: the signed batch requested 3873 cents, but the refund ledger shows only 1083 cents applied (2790 cents short). Orders 203 (18687) and 204 (11000) match. Paying net balances as-is could overpay the customer tied to order 201. Needs human review of the order 201 refund before any payouts.
